areas.name: Arrival Green
areas.prompt: Draw the quietest thing you can see.
areas.welcome: The green is open. Take a slow look around.

areas.name: Lake Path
areas.prompt: Write three colors you see in the water.
areas.welcome: The lake path is open. The water is there when you want it.

areas.name: Tower Court
areas.prompt: Draw one tall shape and one small shape.
areas.welcome: Tower Court is open. Look up, then look down.

areas.name: Library Steps
areas.prompt: Write a sound you hear on the steps.
areas.welcome: The library steps are open. Listen for one sound.

areas.name: Chapel Garden
areas.prompt: Draw something soft you can see nearby.
areas.welcome: Chapel Garden is open. Soft things count here.
